title: More natural Evia movement
details: Evia now makes occasional natural eye movements instead of only staring and blinking
She can glance left, right, up and down, make a small curious head tilt and briefly follow learner taps
The new motion is subtle, respects reduced-motion settings and does not change Evia's layout, data or functionality
summary: Evia v230 adds subtle eye and head reactions so Evia feels more attentive without changing anything else in the learner app.
changes: Brief attention reactions to learner interaction
